note: Verifies whether OSV-Scanner's Go reachability (call analysis) suppresses a High-severity alert when the vulnerable symbol is imported but never called — not timing. No statistical distribution applies: for a fixed source + pinned dependency + pinned advisory, the alert verdict and the called boolean are deterministic. Source of truth: probe-result.json.

fixture.design: reachable/ and unreachable/ share the identical dependency and advisory; only the called function differs (ParseAcceptLanguage vs language.Make).

alert_matrix.question: For two modules with the identical vulnerable dependency, does each scan mode report the vuln?
alert_matrix.key_finding: Naive matching gives BOTH modules the same High alert; the unreachable one is a reproduced false positive. Reachability keeps the alert only where ParseAcceptLanguage is actually reachable from main (called:true, 1 shown) and filters it to zero where it is not (called:false, 0 shown).

demotion_not_deletion.claim: Suppressed findings are demoted, not deleted — audit trail is preserved.
demotion_not_deletion.observed: Adding --all-vulns re-surfaces the filtered GO-2022-1059 under an 'Uncalled vulnerabilities' section rather than dropping it silently.

tradeoff_observed.claim: Reachability is not free — it needs more than a lockfile.
tradeoff_observed.observed: --call-analysis=go required the Go toolchain on PATH and a buildable module; osv-scanner runs the build to construct the call graph ('Will run build scripts'). --no-call-analysis=go worked from go.mod alone.
tradeoff_observed.implication: Reachability cannot run from an SBOM/lockfile in isolation; it raises CI cost and environment requirements.

not_measured.dynamic_dispatch: reflection / dynamic dispatch / cgo can evade a static call graph, so reachability can produce false negatives. Cited from govulncheck docs, NOT exercised here.
not_measured.package_level_advisories: Advisories with no affected-symbol (whole-package) cannot be filtered per-function and are always reported. Cited, not exercised.
not_measured.language_coverage: osv-scanner reachability currently supports Go and Rust only. This run measured Go only.
not_measured.speed: No timing was measured; this is a deterministic alert/called verdict, not a speed benchmark.

cited_not_measured.claim: Go reachability is powered by govulncheck's call-graph analysis.
GO-2022-1059 = CVE-2022-32149: DoS via crafted Accept-Language in golang.org/x/text < 0.3.8.
